blocks.text: From an Olympic silver medal in Tokyo to a bronze in Paris, Nesthy Petecio has established herself as one of the most accomplished boxers in Philippine sports history. She now begins a new journey as an ArenaPlus ambassador. Petecio joins a growing roster of ArenaPlus ambassadors that includes NBA legend Derrick Rose, PBA star Scottie Thompson, and professional golfer Miguel Tabuena, bringing her own brand of determination and championship pedigree to the family. For Petecio, the partnership with ArenaPlus, the No. 1 PAGCOR-licensed online sportsbook in the Philippines, is an opportunity to connect with more Filipinos and inspire the next generation […]...
